name: Burly the Amber-and-White Cat
blurb: Burly, a stocky, muscular amber-and-white shorthair with a white chest, white paws and green eyes, meets the weekly delivery box at the gate.
look: A normal four-legged, stocky, muscular shorthair house cat: an amber coat with a broad white chest and white paws, and green eyes. Wears nothing.
